sections.Profile:
"Solar Ride," a pinball machine released by Gottlieb in February 1979, features a captivating outer space theme designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. This machine was produced in two versions: an electro-mechanical model and a solid-state version.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1979
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Space Fantasy, Space, Original Theme, Scissor Flippers, 1970s, Solid State, Sci-Fi
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Ed Krynski
- Art: Gordon Morison
